PBRInterior - interior PBR materials for the night jewellery-store scene
Prepared October 14, 2026; revised October 15, 2026 after an independent review
(see section 2). Not yet imported or checked in Unity.

Everything in this folder is either CC0 1.0 material from ambientCG (adapted) or
original project work that is offered under CC0 1.0 as well. No attribution is
required; the credits below are given as a courtesy. Commercial use, modification
and redistribution are allowed. Exact mirror repositories, commits, download URLs
and SHA-256 hashes of every source file and every shipped file are in sources.json.

CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication):
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. ambientCG materials (CC0 1.0), created by Lennart Demes / ambientCG
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Publisher licence: https://docs.ambientcg.com/license/ - the ambientCG docs state
that the asset files (and the preview renders) are provided under the Creative
Commons CC0 1.0 Universal licence and that attribution is optional. The same terms
are already recorded in this repository for NightMaterials and PBRExterior.

ambientCG cannot be reached from the build container, so the unmodified 2K-JPG
(Fingerprints009: 4K-JPG) downloads were taken from public GitHub repositories
that committed them as downloaded (ambientCG file names, MaterialX/usdc sidecars
and preview images still present). Those repositories' own licences, where they
have one, cover their code, not these CC0 files. Where a second independent copy
was found, its SHA-256 was compared and matched (listed per asset).

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. Changes made (all by this project, October 14-15, 2026)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 - All maps resampled with a periodic (wrap-padded) Lanczos filter, so every map
   stays seamless; normal maps renormalised and kept in the OpenGL (+Y) convention;
   roughness packed into <Name>_MetallicSmoothness.png as A = 1 - roughness,
   R = metallic, G = B = 0.
 - Colour remaps: StoneTop neutral white; Leather albedo scaled up to a mean of
   about sRGB 30 (median 29); StoneTopDark albedo floor-lifted in linear space
   (c' = 0.009 + k * c, median sRGB 16 -> 39, 5th percentile 5 -> 28, soft
   shoulder on the brightest veins); Walnut desaturated toward chocolate with half of the broad
   banding flattened; PlasterWarm, VelvetCharcoal, SuedeCream, BronzeBrushed,
   BrushedSteel, Chrome, BrassPolished and Carpet re-coloured from the source's
   luminance variation; roughness re-graded per material (see sources.json).
 - PlasterWarm: hairline cracks of PaintedPlaster017 (present only in its colour
   map) detected and filled from shifted, tone-matched copies of crack-free
   plaster; the roughness map is patched with the same copies; the scanned
   normal map is only resampled and scaled to 45 % strength.
 - StoneTop, StoneTopDark, Chrome, BrassPolished: no normal map is shipped,
   because the source normal maps are flat (polished surfaces).
 - VelvetCharcoal / SuedeCream: the source weave lines blurred away, an original
   fine pile/nap normal blended on top.
 - FloorTile: original 4 x 4 large-format tile layout (60 cm tiles, joints, bevel,
   lippage, per-tile tone) cut from Marble021; AO from the joints.
 - Wallpaper: original ogee print over the Wallpaper001A paper.
 - GlassSmudge: Fingerprints009 opacity/roughness re-scaled and gated by an
   original cluster mask, plus original wipe arcs and dust; delivered as an RGBA
   overlay with a MetallicSmoothness map and no normal map.
 - Revision after review (October 15, 2026): StoneTopDark_Color rebuilt (floor
   lift above); PlasterWarm rebuilt (crack fill above); CeilingPaint and
   SafeSteel regenerated (section 3); StoneTop_Normal.png, StoneTopDark_Normal.png,
   Chrome_Normal.png, BrassPolished_Normal.png and GlassSmudge_Normal.png removed
   because they carried no relief.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. Project-owned original work (no third-party content)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SafeSteel_* (procedural dark satin powder-coated steel: orange peel, scratch
 clusters, two bare-metal gouges, burnished patches) and CeilingPaint_*
 (procedural matte rolled ceiling emulsion: roller stipple, nine roller lanes,
 tram-line ridges, tonal drift), and the procedural parts listed in 2,
 were generated from scratch by Source~/build_pbr_interior.py (numpy and Pillow,
 fixed seeds), written for this project with Claude on October 14, 2026
 (CeilingPaint and SafeSteel regenerated on October 15, 2026). The
 project owns them and offers them under CC0 1.0. No attribution is required.
 No real brand, logo, trademark or person appears in any map.
